inlines.v: SUGGES'TION, noun A hint; a first intimation, proposal or mention. The measure was adopted at the suggestion of an eminent philosopher. 1. Presentation of an idea to the mind; as the suggestions of fancy or imagination; the suggestions of conscience. 2. Insinuation; secret notification or incitement. 3. In law, information without oath.
